home.hero_subtitle: Upload a CV, paste a job description and get personalized feedback in seconds — for free.
home.features_subtitle: One tool — complete analysis of your resume against any position.
home.feature_ai_desc: Gemini AI compares your resume with the job description, finds matches, gaps and gives concrete recommendations.
home.feature_inclusion_desc: Detects potentially discriminatory language and helps attract diverse talent.
home.feature_streaming_desc: Results appear word by word — no waiting, immediately after analysis starts.
home.feature_score_desc: A numeric score from 1 to 10 shows how well your resume fits the specific position.
home.feature_privacy_desc: Your documents are not stored on our servers. They are processed in real time and deleted.
home.feature_keywords_desc: Get a list of missing keywords and notes on the structure and layout of your CV.
home.step1_desc: Drag a PDF or TXT file. We support up to 10 MB without registration.
home.step2_desc: Gemini processes both documents and finds all key indicators.
home.step3_desc: Score, strengths, keywords and concrete recommendations for improvement.
home.cta_subtitle: Join and get AI analysis of your resume for free — no credit card needed.

about.title: What is Joblyze?
about.description: Joblyze is an AI-powered platform designed to help recruitment specialists and HR teams create better job descriptions and find ideal candidates.
about.mission_desc: We believe every organization deserves access to intelligent tools that make hiring fairer, more efficient and more inclusive. Our algorithms analyze job listings for clarity, inclusivity and effectiveness.
about.feature_ai_desc: Gemini AI with real-time streaming result support.
about.feature_for_all_desc: For recruiters, HR teams and managers without technical skills.
about.feature_fast_desc: Full analysis in seconds with concrete actionable recommendations.
about.feature_privacy_desc: Your documents are not stored. Full privacy.
about.cta_subtitle: Analyze your resume for free and get personalized feedback.
